intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kannapolis for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (Celebration of Lights and Winterland Express) through December 30, with the Holiday Model Train Display (December 11 to 13), the Kannapolis Christmas Parade (December 12) and A Christmas Carol at the Swanee Theatre (December 18 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kannapolis

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Kannapolis
  • 4 free events, including the Kannapolis Christmas Parade and the Holiday Model Train Display
  • Meet Santa: free photos with Santa at the Celebration of Lights in Village Park, and Cookies and Cocoa with Santa at Message Community Church
  • Parades and trains: the Kannapolis Christmas Parade on December 12, the Winterland Express and the model train display at the Swanee Theatre
  • Season: November 13, 2026 to December 30, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Kannapolis families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charlotte, which covers Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville, Winterfest at Carowinds, the Nutcracker at Belk Theater and Light the Knights at Truist Field.
